Election officials in Kansas and Michigan advised voters to abandon mail voting entirely and use drop boxes instead.

NILC says new applicants are subject to the restrictions immediately under USDA guidance, while households already receiving SNAP are affected at recertification; it also notes confusion in the implementation guidance. Because SNAP eligibility is household-based, eligible U.S.-citizen family members may continue receiving benefits even when another member becomes ineligible. The original wording that the law eliminated benefits for all legal immigrants is too broad.
